title: Trigonometry Quiz 1
description: Know the standard values and convert angles.
instructions: Write maths answers with the keypad. Any equal form is accepted.
Every question has a trap. Slow down at the signs.

questions.question: What is the exact value of $\sin30^\circ$?
What is the exact value of $\cos60^\circ$?
questions.explanation: $\cos60^\circ=\dfrac12$. Watch out: $\cos30^\circ$ is the one with the root.

questions.question: What is the exact value of $\tan45^\circ$?
questions.explanation: At $45^\circ$ sine and cosine are equal, so $\tan45^\circ=1$. Watch out: $\sqrt3$ is $\tan60^\circ$.

questions.question: What is the exact value of $\tan60^\circ$?
Convert $60^\circ$ to radians.
questions.explanation: $60\times\dfrac{\pi}{180}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$. Watch out: multiply by $\dfrac{\pi}{180}$, not by $\dfrac{180}{\pi}$.

questions.question: $\sin(90^\circ)=0$.
questions.explanation: $\sin90^\circ=1$; it is $\cos90^\circ$ that is $0$. Watch out: sine peaks at $90^\circ$.

questions.question: $\sin^{2}x+\cos^{2}x=1$ for every angle $x$.
questions.explanation: This is the Pythagorean identity. Watch out: it holds for all $x$, positive or negative.

questions.question: If $\sin x=\dfrac35$ and $x$ is acute, find $\cos x$ as a decimal.
questions.explanation: $\cos^2x=1-\dfrac{9}{25}=\dfrac{16}{25}$, so $\cos x=0.8$. Watch out: for an acute angle take the positive root.

questions.question: Match each angle with its sine.
questions.explanation: Read each value from the unit circle. Watch out: $\sin270^\circ=-1$, the lowest point of the wave.
